وقتی تغییرهای state چند نوع هستند، می‌تو: When state has several update types, collect their logic in a reducer. An Action describes what happened, such as { type: "added" }. A reducer receives the previous value and Action, then returns the next value.

گاهی چند بخش دور از هم به یک داده مثل سب: Sometimes distant sections need the same data, such as a cart. A Store holds shared memory. Redux Toolkit uses createSlice to define initial state, update logic and generated Actions together.

در createSlice می‌توان ظاهراً state را ت: createSlice permits code that appears to mutate state; Toolkit uses Immer to create a new version. Ordinary React state does not permit this. Small input state usually remains local useState.
داده‌ای که از سرور می‌آید با حالت محلی م: Server data differs from local state, such as whether a window is open. React Query retains request results and manages waiting, errors and refetching. A cache is the stored result for later use.
QueryClient مدیریت cache را انجام می‌دهد: QueryClient manages the cache and QueryClientProvider supplies it to children. useQuery needs queryKey to identify data and queryFn to fetch it. Include every request input, such as city, in the key.
isPending یعنی داده هنوز آماده نیست، isE: isPending means data is not ready, isError means fetching failed, and data holds the response. staleTime is how long data counts as fresh, not how long it stays in the cache.

Mutation برای عملیات تغییر سرور مثل افزو: Mutations change server data, such as adding an order. After success, refresh the relevant cache. This exercise uses a local cache so the change is immediately visible.
نتیجه‌ای که از داده‌های فعلی حساب می‌شود: A result calculated from current data is derived data, such as products matching a search. Calculate it during rendering; a separate Effect and state are usually unnecessary.
قبل از بهینه‌کردن ببین کدام کار هزینه دا: Identify expensive work before optimizing. Component call counts help observe behavior, but laboratory timings do not measure real application performance.
